principles: Re-apply the already-reviewed fix verbatim; do not re-derive logic that two host providers already vetted.
Land the complete fix in ONE DEV commit + ONE comprehensive smoke so the test-coverage lane converges in a single review round.
Keep the blast radius minimal: only the four touched files change; the anthropic/claude path and the adapters stay byte-identical.
Project surfaced usage to ONLY adapter-read token keys via own-property reads into a null-prototype object (defense-in-depth, no prototype-chain leakage).
Never throw from recordDispatchFinalForProvider; a malformed-but-object usage must still supersede the preflight estimate with one unavailable-final.
drivers: The fix is already reviewed (claude 3 lanes + genuine Codex host-2) on the discarded B-fe1f; the only goal is a clean single-round Lattice audit trail.
B-fe1f tangled because multiple test-coverage nit-rounds + concurrent main-drift restaled the lane passes; this re-do must avoid multi-round accumulation.
The broader systematic prototype-pollution class (assemble.ts default-options, adapter `in` reads, protected files) is explicitly DEFERRED to a dedicated story per operator decision.

options.name: apply-captured-fix-verbatim
pros: Re-uses the exact reviewed content from /tmp/fe1f-final/ -- zero re-derivation risk.
Single DEV commit + single smoke keeps the test-coverage lane converging in one review round.
Minimal blast radius; anthropic path and adapters untouched.
cons: Depends on the /tmp capture remaining intact (mitigated: verified present, 4 files).
Carries the deferred systematic prototype-pollution class as a known follow-up (mitigated: documented in background + a separate story is planned).

options.name: re-derive-fix-from-scratch
cons: Throws away the genuine 2-host review already done -- would need a fresh full review.
High risk of subtle divergence from the vetted content (e.g. missing the nested prompt_tokens_details null-proto).
Slower; defeats the purpose of the clean re-do.

rationale: The fix was already implemented and reviewed by claude 3 lanes plus a genuine Codex host-2 on B-fe1f; B-fe1f was discarded only because its review-binding state tangled, not because the code was wrong. Re-applying the captured files verbatim in one commit gives a clean single-round audit trail with zero re-derivation risk, which is exactly the operator's decision.

preMortem.scenario: The re-applied extractor silently drops a cache token field, breaking cacheRead accounting.
preMortem.trigger: pickCodexUsageKeys / pickGeminiUsageKeys omit prompt_tokens_details / cachedContentTokenCount from the null-proto projection.
preMortem.consequence: Surfaced reportedUsage loses cacheRead; ledger under-reports cached tokens.
preMortem.mitigation: Apply the captured files verbatim (they keep those keys); the smoke asserts cache-field preservation explicitly; full npm test must be green.

preMortem.scenario: recordDispatchFinalForProvider throws on a malformed-but-object usage, orphaning the preflight estimate.
preMortem.trigger: buildProviderRecord validation throw is not caught by an inner try, so the unavailable-final is never appended.
preMortem.consequence: The estimate is left as the final record (the exact B-12d7 bug recurs).
preMortem.mitigation: Captured dispatch-usage.ts wraps buildProviderRecord+append in an inner try that falls through to one unavailable-final; the smoke asserts malformed-object -> unavailable-final-supersedes + never-throws for openai and gemini.

preMortem.scenario: Concurrent main-merge drift restales the lane passes mid-review and the round tangles like B-fe1f.
preMortem.trigger: An unrelated story merges to main between review_run_start and DONE, churning the whole-tree materialHash.
preMortem.consequence: Lane passes go stale; resolved-finding exemption fails; DONE blocks; multi-round churn.
preMortem.mitigation: Single DEV commit + single comprehensive smoke = one review round; right before DONE run recover_evidence (refresh_stale + validate) and re-bind escalation/floor verdicts at the current materialHash, retrying the merge-lock.

preMortem.scenario: Scope creep: the implementer 'improves' the deferred systematic prototype-pollution class while applying the fix.
preMortem.trigger: Touching assemble.ts default-options or the adapters' `in` reads beyond the four captured files.
preMortem.consequence: Blast radius widens into protected files; scope contract violated; review re-opens.
preMortem.mitigation: scope_contract_set mode=enforce allowsModify ONLY the four files; protectedFiles lists assemble.ts/adapters/claude-cli.ts; the implementer is instructed to apply verbatim and change nothing else.
